tools.name: subiectele_zilei
tools.description: Today's main news stories in Romania, from Agregator.ro: each one covered by at least two Romanian outlets, most important first, with every outlet's headline and link. Updated hourly from 08:00 to midnight, Bucharest time; before 08:00 it returns last night's latest stories. In Romanian.
